name: Shrieking Souls
disable: DC 44 Diplomacy check (master) to comfort the spirit or DC 45 Occultism check (master) to ward off the spirit

items.name: Scream
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---

text: A terrified soul releases an earsplitting scream.
